prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1383; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in on the roadway in League City, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving in the right lane on a main road heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was already coming to a stop.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car was pushed forward into the vehicle in front of me.

Q: Did you hit the vehicle ahead of you?

A: I believe my front bumper made light contact with it, but the main impact was from the rear.

Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?

A: My left wrist hurt right away. I couldn't grip the steering wheel properly, and I had a lot of pain.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: Yes, I was taken to an urgent care clinic that same day. They took X-rays and told me I had a fracture in my wrist. I've been wearing a splint since then and have an appointment with a specialist next week.

Q: Have you been able to return to work?

A: Not yet. My job requires a lot of typing and lifting, so I've been on light duty at home while the wrist heals.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that the other driver admitted at the scene that they had been looking at their phone. I'd like that noted in the report.

Q: Thank you. We will follow up with you once we have reviewed the information.

A: Thank you.
